reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest update on the music system in Provincia! We've implemented a new audio feature that ensures smooth transitions between day, night, title, and combat music beds. Instead of hard cuts, a long equal-power self-crossfade now seamlessly blends the tracks, enhancing your gaming experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
